Resolves #18951

The grid cell-editing fixture keeps both grids inside the window. Its outside-focus button now sits in its own strip above the app, and the `Viewport` fills the rest at the window's full width. Before, the button shared a centered flex row with a 100%-wide `Viewport`, so the overflow split both ways. The button rendered at x = −31 with its label clipped, which is what @tobiu saw. Both grids started at x = 31, with the locked-end `Note` and `c39` columns partly outside the window in every arm on this fixture.

Evidence: L2 (e2e + component tiers, real Chromium at 1400×900) → L2 required (the fixture's layout and every arm that runs on it). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC-1 | Measured at 1400×900 on the committed file: button x = 4, 117 × 21, not clipped; both grids x = 0, 1400 wide (was: button x = −31, grids x = 31) |
| AC-2 | The button stays a plain `<button>` in `index.html` outside the Neo `Viewport`; `app.mjs` is untouched |
| AC-3 | All nine specs on the fixture pass: component `grid/CellEditing` + `grid/ColumnId` 30/30; e2e `grid/CellEditing*` (6 specs) + `grid/KeyboardNavigationScroll` 47/47. The pooled grid renders 18 rows instead of 19 in the 871 px left; no arm counts them |
